title: UD Quon CW26-390 FUPS Compliant Polished Aluminium Custom Built Bullbar #17
description: UD Quon CW 26-390 hi-tensile FUPS compliant polished aluminium heavy duty Bullbar with additional main cross centre rail for added protectIon. Contoured cross tubes are 76mm tube recessed into the heavy duty 100mm wide outer box uprights and 76mm wide inner box uprights mounted on a reinforced 100mm diameter heavy wall high tensile aluminium bar. Mounted on a high tensile heavy duty aluminium backing plate. The extended higher centre section gives extra protection to the cab. Driving light mounts can be fitted to your requirements. Total weight= 110kg.
